profile.name: VXI-11仪器通信客户端
profile.description: 用于通过 VXI-11/RPC 协议与网络实验仪器建立连接并交换数据的非物理软件组件。它提供原始读写、状态字读取、触发、清除、远程/本地切换、锁定控制，以及底层链路创建、打包与解包等通用通信功能，适合在实验自动化中连接支持 VXI-11 的仪器。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for connecting to and exchanging data with networked laboratory instruments via the VXI-11/RPC protocol. It provides raw read/write, status-byte reading, trigger, clear, remote/local switching, lock control, and low-level link creation plus packet packing/unpacking for automation workflows with VXI-11-capable instruments.

A non-physical software component for connecting to and exchanging data with networked laboratory instruments via the VXI-11/RPC protocol. It provides raw read/write, status-byte reading, trigger, clear, remote/local switching, lock control, and low-level link creation plus packet packing/unpacking for automation workflows with VXI-11-capable instruments.
